blocks.text: Azure mailbox and identity kickoff notes, February 9

This is the working cut for WTS-MTG-2023-007 on February 9, 2023. Brett Holtz asked for a written bound after the current path (On-prem identity, no tenant license count Brett will sign) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host conf-02.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on skip kickoff and enable Azure AD Connect defaults, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Write requirements first. Hybrid mailbox. Identity feed stays Azure AD Connect. Nimbus is out. First useful slice the week of March 20, not February 17. I am not restating a hallway yes. skip kickoff and enable Azure AD Connect defaults is out because Defaults would have synced the lab OU (41 stale accounts) into the tenant. Owen flagged it on the call. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at lab=41, weeks=6, vendor_days=11, seats=214, shared=37, cost=18.4, room=02, hours=1.4. Sibling tickets WTS-4418 and WTS-REQ-2023-011. I will not reopen skip kickoff and enable Azure AD Connect defaults in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
